item.tib: rig 'dzin yab sras rnam gsum thugs sgrubs las dbal mo'i tshogs bskul
item.coloph: ces par gyim shod shel brag tu sa phag zla 1tshes rig 'dzin tshogs gral nas rgyud lung brtsal bzhin slar mad+hal ri khrod du shing sbrul zla 10 tshes 9 la tshe dbang chen po'i (pos) lo chen gyi br+d+wa' yig gnang ba la kho bo g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag gis tshes 10kyi nyi shar dkar shog phab pa'o bkra shis so
